{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value -1 in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment counts:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check distribution of converted
print("Converted counts:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders:", (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
